name: adg
description: Gates that check what an AI coding agent claims about its own work, not only what it wrote.

interface.longDescription: Breaks your code on purpose and reports the breaks no test noticed, runs a change's new tests against the code from before it, and fails a delivery-report claim with nothing behind it.
defaultPrompt: Run the delivery gates on this change.
Break this code on purpose and show what no test caught.
Check my delivery report against the proof obligations.
